description: List the AI image, video, music, sound-effect, and 3D models available on BudgetPixel, plus the depth-map tool's sizes, with standard credit prices and capabilities. Featured models come first with a one-line role hint (when to pick each). Image models that charge by output size list every size's price (the size you pass as resolution sets the price). Video models are priced per SECOND by resolution; music models are flat per track; sound effects are per second with a 3-second minimum; 3D models are priced per job (base price plus named options); depth maps (generate_depth_map) are priced per second of the input video by model size (small / base / large), 5-second minimum. Prices shown are standard rates in credits. Video resolutions delivered as H.265 (HEVC) instead of H.264 are marked, because some browsers cannot play H.265.
name: list_models
title: List Models
